tool.name: ECAFinalTool

param.name: estimate_gdb
param.dialogReference: The output geodatabase from a previous Estimate run. The tool reads the watershed boundary, sub-basins, H60 split, BEC zones, clipped DEM, and metadata from this GDB. The Openings and OtherOpenings feature classes should be reviewed and adjusted before running this tool.

param.name: output_folder
param.dialogReference: Folder where the ECA_Final.gdb and report spreadsheets will be created.

param.name: recovery_curves
param.dialogReference: Excel workbook (.xlsx) containing recovery curve parameters. Each sheet represents a field team (tab name must match the Field_Team value). Columns: BEC_Zone, BEC_Subzone, h0-h5 (height breakpoints in metres), cc0-cc4 (crown closure breakpoints in percent). Leave BEC_Subzone blank for zone-level curves; fill it for subzone overrides.

tool.summary: Performs the final ECA analysis after manual review. Run this after inspecting and adjusting the Openings (and optionally OtherOpenings) feature class in the Estimate output GDB. The tool reuses the watershed, DEM, H60, and BEC layers from the Estimate run — no SDE connections or layer configuration spreadsheet required.
